result.summary: PASS. Q1 (cause): the guard 'if (from === "result" && state.screen !== "result") return;' stands in tools/src/picker/public/app.js:516 right after the stale-ticket check and before both late paths (langFailed, newVersion); nothing is swallowed or hidden, no new state or text. It is the right place: the guard that existed stood only in the same-version branch (after postResult), so the two early branches were open. A change begun on another screen is not affected (from !== "result"); a return to the result screen through send() bumps the ticket (app.js:426), so the ticket check drops that old change. Q2 (record): matches decisions/0078 item 11 ('a change begun on the result screen is dropped if the visitor left the screen') and design rule L4; the comment above changeLanguage is still true; decisions/0073 and 0074 are untouched (no diff against the base tag), no REQ/decisions words in public/ comments (QS-6 green). The design text says in L1 and L4 that leaving the screen wins over a new version and over a failure, which is what the code does. Q3 (extra work): step 12 added one line (the swap of makeHead/commitLanguage in newVersion is the earlier step 09); step 13 touched only picker-page.test.js and the design doc; helpers file and src/ not changed. Q4 (bar): grep for skip/todo/only/eslint-disable/|| true over app.js and picker-page*.js finds nothing; no test removed (tests 64/23/12 pass, skipped 0, todo 0). Q5: idioms as in the neighbouring code; AP-014 compared: the other places of the same kind are the ticket check and the postResult guard, both consistent; the old inner check at app.js:522 is now redundant and harmless (note only, no await between it and the new guard). Tests: QP-9k and QP-9l have independent oracles (values taken from the page after the visitor left and before the late answer, literal 'ru' for the language, literal 0 blocks, a fixed foreign version string; nothing imported from the page code), check the unchanged state (screen, question, language, address search and hash, replaceState count, document title, storage content, set and remove counts, number of GET and POST, no notice, no net block anywhere and none in the header slot, aria-current of all buttons), try both exits (Back, Start over) and both failures (500, network), and then check that the next press works. So each test catches its own path and does not depend on the other. QP-9j (same version) stays green on the mutant, as before.
